scope: Compile-only factory symbol and argument-record audit; no live services, object layouts, concrete casts, lifecycle, link/load, or menu success.

helpers.name: pipeFactory
helpers.return_contract: Owned concrete CCPipe subtype pointer or null; actual kind dispatch uses u32 options+0, log=0/data=1. Options pointer must be non-null.

helpers.name: streamFactory
helpers.return_contract: Owned concrete CCStream subtype pointer or null; requires matching real pipe subtype. The log initializer consumes the entire 0x358-byte record.

helpers.name: faultReporterFactory
helpers.return_contract: Owned CCFaultReporter pointer or null. Retains real CCDataStream and IOWorkLoop and owns a timer/event source; not a log stream or arbitrary OSObject.

helpers.name: wifiFaultWrapperFactory
helpers.return_contract: Owned IO80211FaultReporter wrapper pointer or null. Retains the raw CCFaultReporter; this wrapper is the controller getFaultReporterFromDriver return type.
